description: This PHP file defines a controller class SaveOAuthClientController within the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin, responsible for preparing data for the OAuth Client Save view by setting up a Vue component with optional 'id' property.

classes.name: SaveOAuthClientController
classes.description: A controller class handling the preparation of the OAuth client save view, extending AbstractVueController and creating a Vue component with an optional 'id' property based on the request.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by creating an 'oauth-client-save' component and adding an 'id' prop if an 'id' parameter exists in the request query.
